# Package `encoding`

```go
package encoding
```

Package encoding defines interfaces shared by packages that convert data to and from byte-level and textual representations.

## Types

### type BinaryAppender

```go
type BinaryAppender interface { ... }
```

BinaryAppender is implemented by a value that can append its binary representation. AppendBinary must preserve the existing buffer prefix.

#### method BinaryAppender.AppendBinary

```go
AppendBinary(buffer []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendBinary appends the binary representation to buffer and returns the extended buffer.

### type BinaryMarshaler

```go
type BinaryMarshaler interface { ... }
```

BinaryMarshaler is implemented by a value that can marshal itself into a binary form.

#### method BinaryMarshaler.MarshalBinary

```go
MarshalBinary() (data []byte, err error)
```

MarshalBinary encodes the receiver into a binary form.

### type BinaryUnmarshaler

```go
type BinaryUnmarshaler interface { ... }
```

BinaryUnmarshaler is implemented by a value that can unmarshal a binary representation of itself. UnmarshalBinary must copy data if it retains it after returning.

#### method BinaryUnmarshaler.UnmarshalBinary

```go
UnmarshalBinary(data []byte) error
```

UnmarshalBinary decodes the form generated by MarshalBinary.

### type TextAppender

```go
type TextAppender interface { ... }
```

TextAppender is implemented by a value that can append its textual representation. AppendText must preserve the existing buffer prefix.

#### method TextAppender.AppendText

```go
AppendText(buffer []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendText appends the textual representation to buffer and returns the extended buffer.

### type TextMarshaler

```go
type TextMarshaler interface { ... }
```

TextMarshaler is implemented by a value that can marshal itself into UTF-8-encoded text.

#### method TextMarshaler.MarshalText

```go
MarshalText() (text []byte, err error)
```

MarshalText encodes the receiver into UTF-8 text.

### type TextUnmarshaler

```go
type TextUnmarshaler interface { ... }
```

TextUnmarshaler is implemented by a value that can unmarshal a textual representation of itself. UnmarshalText must copy text if it retains it after returning.

#### method TextUnmarshaler.UnmarshalText

```go
UnmarshalText(text []byte) error
```

UnmarshalText decodes the form generated by MarshalText.
